mapper.select: select concat('s_',img_uuid,'_',filename) from image where post_no=#{post_no} and ord = 0

select brand_id from brand where cate_id in
#{cate_id}

select * from post p join member m on p.member_uuid = m.member_uuid join (select post_no, sum(like_number) as likes from like_record WHERE `date` BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY AND CURRENT_DATE() group by post_no) lr on lr.post_no = p.post_no where p.state=1 order by likes desc limit 0, 10

select p.*, (post_like*star) as 'score', name, star from post p join post_brand pb on p.post_no = pb.post_no join brand b on b.brand_id = pb.brand_id join member m on p.member_uuid = m.member_uuid join ( select post_no, avg(star) as 'star' from star group by post_no) s on p.post_no = s.post_no where cate_id = #{cate_id} and p.state = 1 group by p.post_no order by score desc limit 0, #{size}
select p.*, name from post p join member m on p.member_uuid = m.member_uuid where p.state = 1 order by reg_date desc limit 0, 3
